review.requestQuote: Please approve those runs when you are ready for the upstream checks to execute.
review.scope: Answer only the verified specific request on #422; report exact source, remediation, remaining admission and runtime limits. No general future communication permission.

responseBody:
Reviewed both #422 and #1178 against current main. The Tool-view ownership review gate is already enforced independently of self-declared package/key prefixes. We also integrated the missing Windows scan-report path fix into the current builder, with POSIX/Windows regression coverage.

Both PR heads currently conflict with main. Their old action_required runs have not been represented as passing CI, and the obsolete conflicting heads were not enabled to run privileged workflows. The integrated change is going through current-main CI instead. This reply covers the two exact PRs named in your request; it does not claim those historical runs were approved.

[Reviewed source and disposition record](https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store/blob/main/docs/reviews/github-backlog-20261016.md). Read-only review; no third-party scripts, installation, or real Profile acceptance performed.
